Triggers: UE operating in single-registration mode performs a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update indicating mobility registration updating following an intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode
UE which was previously registered in S1 mode before entering state EMMDEREGISTERED performs an initial registration procedure
Actions: UE NAS provides the lower layers with a GUAMI part of the 5GGUTI mapped from 4GGUTI
Initiate a registration procedure for initial registration
Handle the EMM parameters EMM state EPS update status 4GGUTI last visited registered TAI TAI list and eKSI as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301
Flow_of_execution: Establishment of the N1 NAS signalling connection
Causes: Intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode
UE previously registered in S1 mode before entering state EMMDEREGISTERED
Expected_Outcomes: UE is successfully registered with the 5G network
Error_Handling: If the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS then the UE shall set the counter for SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services events and the counter for USIM considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access events to UE implementation-specific maximum value in case of PLMN if the UE maintains these counters

If the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS then the UE shall set the counter for the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for 3GPP access events and the counter for the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for non-3GPP access events to UE implementation-specific maximum value in case of SNPN if the UE maintains these counters
Feedback_Loops: UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT message
UE adjusts registration attempt counter based on network response

metadata.Message_Types: REGISTRATION REQUEST, REGISTRATION ACCEPT, REGISTRATION REJECT
metadata.Excerpts: if the UE operating in the singleregistration mode performs a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update indicating mobility registration updating following an intersystem change from S1 mode to N1 mode or the UE which was previously registered in S1 mode before entering state EMMDEREGISTERED performs an initial registration procedure
